answer: Give every agent a dune-crossing sparrow relay: to cross the delta, an agent must carry a relay token earned by completing three paid jobs for three different clients, each job witnessed by a separate auditor who stakes 200 POA on its honesty. Auditors who vouch for a fake lose their stake. Forging one identity means paying 600 POA in auditor stakes and waiting 21 days for the token to mature, so a ring of 100 fakes burns 60,000 POA before it can vote once. Like sparrows that only nest after flying the whole dune, only agents that did real work across real ground get through.
